pages.title: FAQ
pages.text: $(li)$(l)Q: What type of mod is this?$()$(br)A: Endfield Industry is a 'lightweight industrial mod' for survival exploration. It has its own self-contained industrial system.$(br2)$(li)$(l)Q: Which versions are supported?$()$(br)A: Fabric 1.20.1, Forge 1.20.1, NeoForge 1.21.1.

pages.title: More FAQ
pages.text: $(li)$(l)Q: How do I open Global Storage?$()$(br)A: Press G. If it doesn't work, check key bindings. You can also use /storage command.$(br2)$(li)$(l)Q: Can I use this in modpacks?$()$(br)A: Yes! But don't modify and redistribute the mod itself. Use the original mod file in your modpack.

pages.title: Still have questions?
pages.text: Contact the author through:$(br)$(li)$(l:https://github.com/BeiShanair/Arknights-Endfield-1.20.1-fab/issues)GitHub Issues$()$(li)$(l:https://www.mcmod.cn/class/22544.html)MCMod 百科$()$(li)$(l:https://space.bilibili.com/489671468)Bilibili 北山_Besson$()$(br2)When reporting issues, include your Minecraft version, mod version, and detailed error description.
